comment: Every statement the product runs against pgokf_web.users/sessions (scripts/catalog_parity.py product_statements; tests/test_release_integrity.py keeps this list equal to the source), with the arguments (and, where not 00000, the SQLSTATE) scripts/upgrade-parity.py executes them with, in order, as pgokf_writer, against a fresh catalog and against each reconciled catalog that keeps the declared column order. The transcripts must be identical.

statements.sql: SELECT 1 FROM pgokf_web.users LIMIT 0
SELECT 1 FROM pgokf_web.sessions LIMIT 0
SELECT count(*) FROM pgokf_web.users
SELECT role, password_hash, display_name, provider FROM pgokf_web.users WHERE name = $1
SELECT name, role, display_name, provider, count(*) OVER () FROM pgokf_web.users WHERE $1 = '' OR name ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '\' OR display_name ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY name LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
SELECT count(*) FROM pgokf_web.users WHERE $1 = '' OR name ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '\' OR display_name ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '\'
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pgokf_web.users WHERE name = $1)
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pgokf_web.sessions WHERE nonce = $1 AND subject = $2 AND mode = $3 AND expires_at > now() )
SELECT count(*) FROM pgokf_web.sessions WHERE subject = $1 AND expires_at > now()
SELECT subject, count(*) FROM pgokf_web.sessions WHERE expires_at > now() GROUP BY subject ORDER BY subject
INSERT INTO pgokf_web.users (name, role, password_hash, display_name) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
INSERT INTO pgokf_web.users (name, role, password_hash, display_name, provider) VALUES ($1, $2, NULL, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
UPDATE pgokf_web.users SET display_name = $3, updated_at = now() WHERE name = $1 AND provider = $2 AND display_name IS DISTINCT FROM $3
UPDATE pgokf_web.users SET role = $2, updated_at = now() WHERE provider = $1 AND role <> $2
UPDATE pgokf_web.users SET role = $2, updated_at = now() WHERE name = $1
UPDATE pgokf_web.users SET password_hash = $2, updated_at = now() WHERE name = $1 AND password_hash IS NOT NULL
INSERT INTO pgokf_web.sessions (nonce, subject, mode, provider, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, to_timestamp($5::bigint))
DELETE FROM pgokf_web.sessions WHERE expires_at < now()
DELETE FROM pgokf_web.sessions WHERE nonce = $1
DELETE FROM pgokf_web.sessions WHERE subject = $1
DELETE FROM pgokf_web.sessions WHERE provider = $1
DELETE FROM pgokf_web.users WHERE name = $1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pgokf_web.users) > 1
